name: ring/arena presentation
largest_gap: flat-void fraction 0.125 -> 0.008 mean across the five beat frames (0.176 -> 0.009 at the worst of them), and this time it is coverage, not the lens: the hall is a real 20-row raked bowl with ~3,900 instanced spectators, an entrance stage with ramp/tunnel/video wall, and an overhead truss, all generated by core/arena/arena_builder.gd. Every hall surface is held at VISUAL_BAR.md's own measured reference-crowd luminance of 0.014. Read two caveats carefully. First, 0.008 is now BELOW the reference band's 0.010 floor -- we have marginally fewer black pixels than broadcast footage does, so this number is no longer a gap to close and should not be pushed further. Second, and unchanged: lighting consistency (bar priority 2) and material believability (bar priority 3) remain UNJUDGED -- every capture is llvmpipe and evidence_gate.py --visual voids them for this slice. The CC0 ambientCG materials on the hall are therefore unevaluated, not validated. Still absent: crowd figures are two-box impostors with no faces or limbs, the stage carries no branding, and there is no entrance sequence to use it.

name: wrestler look & materials
largest_gap: Measured properly for the first time, and the previous number was not comparable: the old 0.172 came from asserting *albedo* against a 0.24-0.31 read off rendered reference pixels. tools/refs/measure_silhouette.py now reads our own frames the same way the reference table was read. All four figures are inside the reference band -- mat 0.458 (anchor 0.46), mat<->A 0.290, mat<->B 0.291, A<->B 0.001 (allows 0.07). Getting there needed the ring rig at 4.5 rather than 2.2 (at a mat of 0.276 a 0.24 gap below it was arithmetically impossible) and the colourway moved off the whole body onto 15 pieces of gear, leaving the mannequin as skin. What is still missing: no faces, one CC0 mannequin body for both men (build differs only by gear width, physique_bulk 0.94 vs 1.12), gear is untextured cylinders, and material believability (bar priority 3) plus lighting consistency (priority 2) stay UNJUDGED -- every capture is llvmpipe. A<->B at 0.001 is arguably tuned too flat; the reference's own two men differ by 0.07 and ours now differ by nothing.

name: HUD/UI
largest_gap: the vitality bar was reading against a 400-damage scale while the match is played on a 200 one, so a wrestler one hit from losing showed 54-75% health; fixed, and each plate now carries its wrestler's own attire accent. Still missing against hud.md: portraits, the fill-animation behaviour hud.md marks pending (easing, flash-on-threshold, damage-tick delay), and legibility across a lighting range the game does not yet have.

name: grapple chain & paired-move quality
largest_gap: The chain now runs in order and both top rungs fire in the same match, which neither did before: over ten AI-vs-AI seeds a signature fired in 9 (was 3), a finisher in 4 (was 7), both in 4 (was 0), and the chain skipped a rung in 0 seeds (was 7). Two mechanisms, neither of them the threshold arithmetic the old gap line blamed. First, a tier gate is only read at a grapple while momentum keeps rising between grapples, so the 8-wide signature band was narrower than the 10-20 a wrestler earns between two reads and a jab could carry him past it -- ordering is now a property of the chain (CombatSystem.tier_reached: each rung needs the one below it landed), not of arithmetic on a rising meter. Second, and larger: knockdown was total_damage() >= KNOCKDOWN_DAMAGE, a latch on a quantity that only rises, so past ~100 damage every later jab re-downed the opponent and tie-ups stopped -- both wrestlers entered GRAPPLE_HOLD exactly three times in every seed and a match played two or three of the eighteen authored paired moves. It is now measured from the last knockdown, and grapple moves per match went 2.8 -> 3.6. What is still missing: the chain is tight against what a match affords (a full climb needs four grapples, a match affords 3.6, hence a finisher in 4 seeds of 10 -- an artefact of the constants, not a measured target); the three thresholds remain reachability values and the frame data, damage and momentum across all 18 paired moves still trace to no reference measurement; a match can still be won almost entirely with jabs (seed 8's winner finished on 66 unspent momentum and 8 strikes) since strikes feed the meter the grapple chain spends; and paired-move *quality* -- the other half of this slice's name -- stays UNJUDGED, because every capture is llvmpipe and evidence_gate.py --visual voids it for that judgement.

name: camera framing
largest_gap: the follow-cam is solved from measurement now -- subject fill 0.29 -> inside the reference's own bands, and the dead cut modes (which froze the camera permanently if ever called) are driven off the match's events. What is not measured: FOV is DERIVED (41 deg, from fill plus 'just outside the near ropes'), the fit's separations are derived from that same FOV rather than observed, and ease curves plus cut duration stay pending real footage per camera.md. The containment guard's width limit is an engineering value, not a reference number.
